description: Runtime TypeScript API needed to bootstrap the project-less typescript-estree parser and convert the returned AST. This inventory deliberately excludes the broader type-aware Program and TypeChecker surface.

requirements.requirement: Parse an isolated in-memory source string into a SourceFile without a project.
Select the latest supported language grammar.
Select JS, JSX, JSON, TS, and TSX parsing modes.
requirements.evidence: create-program/getScriptKind.ts maps file extensions to ts.ScriptKind values.

requirements.requirement: Expose the extension constants evaluated while typescript-estree modules load.
requirements.evidence: create-program/getScriptKind.ts and shared.ts read ts.Extension constants at module evaluation time.

requirements.requirement: Distinguish standard and JSX lexical variants.
Expose SyntaxKind values used throughout AST conversion, token classification, and comments.
requirements.evidence: convert.ts, convert-comments.ts, and node-utils.ts branch extensively on ts.SyntaxKind.

requirements.requirement: Expose declaration flags used to distinguish let, const, using, and await using.
requirements.evidence: node-utils.ts reads ts.NodeFlags during variable-declaration conversion.

requirements.requirement: Convert token kinds into source spellings.
requirements.evidence: node-utils.ts calls ts.tokenToString for ESTree operators and tokens.

requirements.requirement: Identify token nodes while traversing the TypeScript AST.
requirements.evidence: node-utils.ts calls ts.isToken in token-navigation logic.

requirements.requirement: Expose scanner primitives used by TypeScript-compatible comment and token helpers.
requirements.evidence: Token and comment conversion depends on TypeScript-compatible lexical ranges; direct usage is delegated partly through ts-api-utils.

requirements.requirement: Report filesystem case sensitivity when ts.sys is available.
requirements.evidence: create-program/shared.ts reads ts.sys.useCaseSensitiveFileNames with a browser fallback.

requirements.requirement: Hash source content when ts.sys.createHash is available.
Return a SourceFile with text, file metadata, statements, parse diagnostics, and location helpers.
requirements.evidence: ast-converter.ts reads parseDiagnostics; node-utils.ts uses getLineAndCharacterOfPosition; parser conversion consumes SourceFile text and statements.

requirements.requirement: Return nodes with positions, parents, traversal, text, child-token, and source-file methods.
requirements.evidence: convert.ts and node-utils.ts use kind, pos, end, parent, forEachChild, getSourceFile, getStart, getFullStart, getEnd, getChildren, getFirstToken, getLastToken, getFullText, and getText.

requirements.requirement: Expose syntax diagnostics with code, UTF-16 start, and positive length.
requirements.evidence: ast-converter.ts reads SourceFile.parseDiagnostics and convert.ts converts errors using their start and file.
